claims.detail: Committed exemplar: API Management terminates OAuth at the edge while AKS ingress keeps internal-only listeners for cluster traffic.

findings.description: Mesh mTLS assumptions require consistent sidecar upgrades; lagging nodes would weaken east-west guarantees during load tests.
findings.recommendation: Automate canary rollouts and block production promotions when sidecar skew exceeds one minor version.

findings.description: Regional AKS clusters need mirrored autoscaling profiles before Black Friday to avoid asymmetric shard loss.
findings.recommendation: Replay prior peak traces against both regions with Front Door weighting set to production ratios.
